review_method: Source-order full read of all 1200 candidate IDs, including overlap re-reads for ranges truncated by the GitHub output. The fixed English patch was used as the correction baseline and rationale for localization choices; Japanese was consulted only where needed to resolve semantic ambiguity or an apparent fixed-English-reference defect. Korean was judged for accuracy, naturalness, register, terminology, referent/subject/direction handling, and obvious text breakage. Final in-scope result: 28 EDIT and 1172 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. All 28 in-scope proposed before-values were verified against current Korean, and semantic commit 81e161b4a18c0cb834f84a3580dccc5d8fde6edb passed exact-before application, zero-layout-drift checks, the existing Korean gates, and the English-consumer storage/effective-layout contract before review-basis registration. That semantic commit also contains one adjacent typo correction at ID 980111 outside candidate-037; it is not credited to S-037 and will be reviewed when its own candidate scope reaches it. No historical-range cleanup was performed.
